speaker: S1
text: Good evening everyone, and welcome back to our little kitchen show.

speaker: S1
text: Today I am sitting with a very special guest, Mr. Tu, who has been cooking for forty years.

speaker: S2
text: Thank you, Lan. You make me sound so old!

speaker: S1
text: Forty years is a lot of practice, sir. What was the first dish you ever cooked?

speaker: S2
text: Rice porridge, for my mother, when she was sick. I was only nine years old, and I burned the bottom of the pot, so the whole house smelled of smoke for two days, but I was far too proud to start again from the beginning.

speaker: S1
text: Oh no! That is so sweet.

speaker: S2
text: She said it was the best porridge in the world, which was a kind lie.

speaker: S1
text: And what will you teach us today?

speaker: S2
text: A simple fish soup, the way my grandmother made it, with tamarind and a lot of patience.
